68
RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, the March 6, 2003/Phalguna 15, 1924 (Saka)
————
(Ministries:  Prime Minister; Agro and Rural Industries; Atomic Energy;
Communications and Information Technology; Consumer Affairs,
Food and Public Distribution; Development of North Eastern
Region; Disinvestment; External Affairs; Labour; Planning;
Road Transport and Highways; Small Scale Industries;
Space; Statistics and Programme Implementation)
Total number of questions—20
National Highways in Assam
*221. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHW AYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
sanctioned any amount for construction
and widening of various National
Highways in Assam;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the details of the funds likely to be
released for the purpose?
Separate account for different
services
*222. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Telecom Regulatory
Authority of India has ordered phone
companies to maintain separate account
for different services they provide;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether TRAI has taken any steps
to ensure prevention of cross-subsidisation
by phone companies; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Status of SSIs
*223. SHRI SURESH PACHOURI:
Will the Minister of SMALL SCALE
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the present status of the small scale
industries, so far as production and
employment generation are concerned;
(b) whether the reforms process has
weakened the small scale industry sector;
and
(c) if not, how the structural reforms
have strengthened these industries so
far as their economic viability is
concerned?
Assistance to Singapore in
combating terrorism
*224. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Singapore has sought
India's assistance in effectively combating
terrorism; and
(b) if so, the mutual facilitation of the
security services proposed to contain the
threat of terrorism?

Issuance of pa ssports
*225. PROF. M.M. AGARWAL : Will
the Minister of EXTERNAL  AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of passports issued by
the Regional Passport Offices in the
country during the last five years and till
date, Regional Passport Office-wise and
State-wise;
(b) the average time taken by passport
offices in issuing passports;
(c) the number of applications pending
for issuance of passports in the different
passport offices during the last one year;
and
(d) the measures taken or proposed to
be taken by Government to dispose these
applications expeditiously?
National Highways in Himachal
Pradesh
*226. SHRI ANIL SHARMA: Will the
Minister of ROAD TRANSPORT AND
HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) the nature of the development
works undertaken on various National
Highways in Himachal Pradesh during the
last three years;
(b) the time schedule for completion
of each such work; and
(c) the details of the funds sanctioned/
released/utilised for the purpose during
the above period, work-w ise?
US officials' sugg estions to Pakistan
*227. SHRI GHULAM NABI AZAD:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention
has been drawn to the news report which
appeared in the 'Times of India' dated the
31st January, 2003 mentioning about US
officials suggestions to Pakistan to take
steps that could lead to talk with India,
controlling cross-border infiltration,
respecting sanctity of the LoC and also
responding to India's suggestion of
normalising trade relations;
(b) if so, whether Government are
aware that Pakistan was also called into
account for its nuclear proliferation
activity, particularly its ties with North
Korea; and
(c) if so, Government's reaction
thereto?
Kamreda-Warki NH in Gujarat
†*228. SHRIMATI SAVITA
SHARDA: Will the Minister of ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) the present status of construction
of the National Highway from Kamreda
to Warki in Gujarat;
(b) whether the progress of
construction work of the highway is very
slow;
(c) if so, the reasons therefor;
(d) by when the construction work of
the above highway is likely  to be
completed; and
(e) the estimated expenditure to be
incurred on this work?

U.S. help in space research
*229. DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether U.S. was eager to help
India in all ways in  space research; and
(b) if so, the new programme proposed
in space technology with co-operation of
the United States?

RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, the March 6, 2003/Phalguna 15, 1924 (Saka)
————
(Ministries:  Prime Minister; Agro and Rural Industries; Atomic Energy;
Communications and Information Technology; Consumer Affairs,
Food and Public Distribution; Development of North Eastern
Region; Disinvestment; External Affairs; Labour; Planning;
Road Transport and Highways; Small Scale Industries;
Space; Statistics and Programme Implementation)
Total number of questions—155
Reliability of CBI
†1542. SHRI RAMA SHANKER
KAUSHIK: Will the PRIME MINISTER
be pleased to state:
(a) to what extent working of the CBI
is reliable and what has been the source
from which information is leaked before
any action is initiated by the CBI and what
are the reasons therefor; and
(b) the steps Government intend to
take in order to keep the reliability of the
CBI intact, besides streamlining its
functioning and keeping its confidential
aspect intact?
Pradhan Mantri Rozgar Yojana
†1543. PROF. R.B.S. VARMA: Will
the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the funds allocated to the various
States under the Pradhan Mantri Rozgar
Yojana from 1999-2000 onwards,
year-wise;
(b) Uttar Pradesh's share in this regard;
and
(c) by when the next instalment of the
funds is likely to be released?
Growth of Agro and Rural Industries
1544. SHRI SURESH PACHOURI:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the present status of Agro and Rural
Industries, so far, production and
employment generation are concerned; and
(b) the strategy proposed to be adopted
during the Tenth Five Year Plan period for
growth of the agro and rural industries?
Khadi artisans in Andhra Pradesh
1545. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister  of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the number of Khadi artisans in
Andhra Pradesh as on date, district-wise;
and
(b) the details of the welfare measures
Government have extended to these
artisans?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

342
WIN2\SESSION\7789RS.pm5 342
Potential of ARIs in Rajasthan
1546. SHRI R.K. ANAND:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have assessed
potential of the agro industries in
Rajasthan;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) how far this potential is being
utilized; and
(d) what steps Government have taken
to ensure development of the agro
industries in the State and what are the
marketing schemes Government intend to
implement for the same?
Rural industrialisation in Rajasthan
†1547. SHRI MOOLCHAND
MEENA: Will the Minister of AGRO
AND RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) the status of National Programme
for Rural Industrialisation in the
industrially backward districts of
Rajasthan; and
(b) the achievements thereof?
Setting up of nuclear power projects
1548. SHRI P. PRABHAKAR
REDDY: Will the PRIME MINISTER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to set up nuclear power projects in the
country and build 1000 mw reactors in
coastal sites and 700 mw reactors in
identified inland locations;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) by when, the preliminary
formalities are likely to be completed,
sites identified and work started?
Atomic power generation
1549. SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
SHRI GHULAM NABI
AZAD:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a very small
portion of power is generated through the
atomic power plants out of the total power
generation;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the costs of maintaining
atomic plants is viable vis-a-vis the
quantum of power generated by each
atomic plant;
(d) whether Government plan to
upgrade and increase power production in
these plants in the near future; and
(e) if so, by when?
Setting up of atomic power plants
1550. SHRI S.M. LAL JAN BASHA:
SHRI T.S. BAJWA:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have proposals to set up more plants to
generate atomic energy for peaceful
purposes;
(b) if so, what are the plans for such an
expansion in the Tenth Plan;
(c) whether adequate finance has been
identified for this purpose;
(d) the details of the new locations
where such power plants would be set up;
